Payout of 9 July is short ₹20,013.60.
The bank credited ₹1,76,274.08 against an expected ₹1,96,287.68. 24 orders sit in this payout. This is consistent with refund rfnd_000022 of ₹20,013.60, issued 23 July against payment pay_000170. Refunds are deducted from the cycle that processes them, not the cycle of the original sale, so a payout can be reduced by a refund against a much earlier purchase.
Suggested action: verify rfnd_000022 in the refund report and confirm it was deducted from this payout. The amounts match, which is not proof of cause -- rfnd_000022 is booked to another cycle, so the link is not confirmed.
